definitions.gloss: recipient; receiving party; place of receipt
definitions.explanation: The person, company, or location that receives goods, money, or a delivery. A form-filling and business term rather than conversational vocabulary.

examples.japanese: {受取先|うけとりさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{受取先|うけとりさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}した→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧。
examples.english: I changed the pickup location to a convenience store.

examples.japanese: {受取先|うけとりさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っていた→間違う：03036_machigau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きてしまった。
examples.english: The recipient's address was wrong, so the package came back.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive) plus 〜⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧, the suffix that names the other party or destination of an action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受取先|うけとりさき}⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: recipient's address
- {受取先|うけとりさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to specify the recipient
- {受取先|うけとりさき}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: change of recipient

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送|おく}り{先|さき}→送り先：23506_okurisaki⟧: destination for sending — the same delivery seen from the sender's side
- ⟦{宛先|あてさき}→宛先：12275_atesaki⟧: addressee — the address written on the item itself
- ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧: business partner — a parallel 〜⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ compound worth learning alongside this one
